behavior.name: 0x13004770
behavior.description: Spawns a circle of Goombas (or Floombas if oIsFloomba is set) when Mario is within 3000 units. The number of spawned Goombas is 3 + (Extra Goombas). Spawns are tracked via bitflags in oBehParams to prevent respawning killed Goombas. Unloads children when Mario is further than 4000 units.
